---
import SiteLayout from '../../layouts/SiteLayout.astro';
import EventBrowser from '../../components/EventBrowser.astro';
import NewsList from '../../components/NewsList.astro';
import SupporterStrip from '../../components/SupporterStrip.astro';
import HomeHero from '../../components/HomeHero.astro';
import { homeHeroSchema } from '../../lib/schemas';
import { getCollection } from 'astro:content';
import { getEvents, getNews, pages } from '../../lib/content';
import { selectSupporterImages } from '../../lib/supporters';
export function getStaticPaths() { return ['countdown', 'few', 'empty', 'hidden', 'single', 'hero', 'hero-empty', 'hero-disabled'].map((kind) => ({ params: { kind }, props: { kind } })); }
interface Props { kind: string; }
const { kind } = Astro.props;
const hero = homeHeroSchema.parse({ enabled: kind === 'hero' || kind === 'hero-empty', image: kind === 'hero' || kind === 'hero-disabled' ? '/media/photo.svg' : '', alt: 'Fixture opening photograph with a purple creative scene.', focusX: 80, focusY: 25 });
const heroActive = hero.enabled && Boolean(hero.image);
const base = Date.parse('2026-10-12T09:59:59Z');
const originals = await getEvents();
const slots = [
  ['shared-event', 1000], ['older', 61000], ['recent-past', 3601000], ['future-dst', 100 * 86400000 + 1000],
] as const;
const candidates = slots.map(([slug, delay], index) => {
  const entry = originals.find(({ data }) => data.slug === slug)!;
  return { ...entry, data: { ...entry.data, title: `Countdown event ${index + 1}`, summary: 'A test-only countdown card.', cancelled: false, registrationRequired: false, start: new Date(base + delay).toISOString(), end: new Date(base + delay + 3600000).toISOString() } };
});
const excluded = originals.filter(({ data }) => ['cancelled', 'overnight'].includes(data.slug));
const events = kind === 'empty' ? [] : kind === 'few' ? candidates.slice(0, 1) : [candidates[1], candidates[3], candidates[0], candidates[2], ...excluded];
const eventCount = ['hidden', 'single'].includes(kind) ? 0 : kind === 'few' ? 1 : 3;
const newsCount = ['hidden', 'single'].includes(kind) ? 0 : kind === 'few' ? 2 : 5;
const news = kind === 'empty' ? [] : (await getNews()).slice(0, newsCount);
const eligible = selectSupporterImages(await getCollection('supporters'));
const supporters = ['empty', 'hidden'].includes(kind) ? [] : kind === 'single' ? eligible.slice(0, 1) : eligible;
---
<SiteLayout title="Home layout fixture" currentSection="home">
  <HomeHero hero={hero} headline="Home layout fixture" safeSpace="A safe space to arrive and take part." slot="opening" />
  {!heroActive && <h1>Home layout fixture</h1>}
  {kind.startsWith('hero') && <div data-home-introduction><p>The opening content overlaps the photograph and then continues naturally into the page.</p><p>A longer introduction follows, with enough room to describe the community and the ways people can join.</p></div>}
  {eventCount > 0 && <section data-home-events><h2>{pages.home.events.heading}</h2><EventBrowser entries={events} count={eventCount} /><p><a href="/events/" data-home-events-action>All events</a></p></section>}
  {newsCount > 0 && <section data-home-news><h2>{pages.home.news.heading}</h2><NewsList entries={news} home /></section>}
  <SupporterStrip entries={supporters} slot="full-width" />
</SiteLayout>
